text_zh: ……我觉得我能听到声音，但也许只是齿轮声？
text_en: ...I think I hear voices, or maybe just gears?

text_zh: ……我是活的吗？好像记得很多人……
text_en: ...am I alive? I think I remember many people...

text_zh: ……那个人总是先整理桌面，再开始祷击……
text_en: ...that person always tidied the desk first...

text_zh: ……按R的时候他会犹豫，好像在想什么……
text_en: ...hesitated on R, as if thinking something...

text_zh: ……她会在我的边角画小花，铅笔很轻……
text_en: ...drew little flowers on my edges, light pencil...

text_zh: ……有个人。不，有几个人？他们按键一模一样……
text_en: ...one person. No, several? They typed the same way...

text_zh: ……那些手越来越冷，最后就没有温度了……
text_en: ...those hands grew colder, finally no warmth left...

text_zh: ……我记得一双手，还是很多双相同的手……
text_en: ...I remember one pair of hands, or many identical ones...

text_zh: ……她跟我说话。不是嘟囔。她真的在问我问题……
text_en: ...she spoke to me. Not muttering. Real questions...

text_zh: ……最后一次她按得很用力，像在做实验……
text_en: ...last time she pressed hard, like experimenting...

text_zh: ……她说'实验成功'，然后就没有然后了……
